purpose: Calibrated full-coordinate extension to the prespecified P2 compact singleton tier after R5C established informative operating characteristics for the clean-RT structural screen.
p2_definition: R4 ProstT5/Foldseek no-hit; 220-500 aa; minimum ORF-to-candidate distance <=250 bp; candidate_key_n == 1
execution: four independent single-GPU shards; no DDP/NCCL
claim_boundary: P2 is a compute-priority extension only. Calibrated structural compatibility can prioritize RT-like proteins but does not establish RT activity or ART identity; no-hit is not a negative classification.
